questions.text: Perfect Continuous aspektining formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Aspekt formulasi har zamonda bir xil: Simple / BE+V-ing / HAVE+V3 / HAVE BEEN+V-ing.

questions.text: «since, for, ever, just, yet» qaysi zamonning kalitlari?
questions.explanation: yesterday/ago/last → Past Simple; hozir/vaqtincha → Present Continuous.

questions.text: «by + kelajak vaqt» qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?
questions.explanation: I'll have finished by Friday.

questions.text: O'tmishdan oldingi voqea qaysi zamonda beriladi?
questions.explanation: had + V3 — «o'tmishdan oldingi o'tmish».

questions.text: Zamon tanlashda birinchi navbatda nimaga qaraladi?
questions.explanation: Signal so'zlar zamon tanlashning eng ishonchli kaliti.

title: Test — Hikoya zamonlari va used to

questions.text: Hikoyaning necha qatlami bor?
questions.explanation: Asosiy voqealar, fon, flashback, flashbackdan oldingi davomiylik.

questions.text: «be used to + V-ing» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: get used to + V-ing — o'rganib borish jarayoni.

questions.text: «would» o'tmish odati sifatida qaysi holatda ishlatilmaydi?
questions.explanation: Holat uchun faqat used to: I used to be shy (I would be — xato).

questions.text: Flashbackdan oldingi davomiylik qaysi zamonda beriladi?
questions.explanation: had been + V-ing — o'sha nuqtagacha qancha vaqt davom etganini ko'rsatadi.

questions.text: Fon va davom etayotgan harakat qaysi zamonda beriladi?
questions.explanation: was/were + V-ing — sahna va uzilgan harakat uchun.

questions.text: «be due to» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: be to / be due to — rasmiy yoki belgilangan reja.

questions.text: «will have been V-ing» nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: will have + V3 — tugaydi; will have been V-ing — davom etgan bo'ladi.

questions.text: «be bound to» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: be likely to — ehtimol; be bound to — muqarrar.

questions.text: «I'll call you as soon as I ___ » — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: when/if/as soon as/until/before/after dan keyin PRESENT.

questions.text: Dalilga asoslangan bashorat uchun qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: will — fikrga asoslangan bashorat; going to — dalilga asoslangan.

questions.text: «will» o'tmishdan kelajakda nimaga aylanadi?
questions.explanation: Reported speech: «I will» → he said he WOULD.

questions.text: «was/were going to» ko'pincha qanday ottenka beradi?
questions.explanation: I was going to call, but I forgot.

questions.text: «was/were about to» qanday ma'no beradi?
options: Shu zahoti bo'lay deb turgan edi (...when... burilishi bilan)
questions.explanation: I was about to leave when the phone rang.

questions.text: «was to have + V3» nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: He was to have arrived yesterday — kelishi kerak edi, kelmadi.

questions.text: «would» ning nechta asosiy ma'nosi bor?
questions.explanation: Ma'noni faqat kontekst ajratadi.

questions.text: Third conditional formulasi qanday?
options: If + had V3, would have V3
questions.explanation: O'tmish noreal: If I had studied, I would have passed.

questions.text: «If I would have known...» — bu nega xato?
options: if-qismda would ishlatilmaydi — faqat had + V3
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: If I had known...

questions.text: «would of» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: Talaffuz o'xshashligidan kelib chiqqan imlo xatosi.

questions.text: «could have + V3» natija qismida qanday ottenka beradi?
questions.explanation: would have (aniq) / could have (imkon) / might have (ehtimol).

questions.text: 2-shart va 3-shart qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: If + Past, would V1 ↔ If + Past Perfect, would have V3.

questions.text: «If I had saved, I would be rich now» — bu qanday aralash shart?
questions.explanation: Mixed 1 — eng ko'p uchraydigan turi; now/today/still bilan keladi.

questions.text: «If I were braver, I would have asked» — bu qanday aralash shart?
questions.explanation: Mixed 2: If + Past Simple, would have + V3.

questions.text: Aralash shartni tuzishning birinchi qadami qaysi?
questions.explanation: 1) Shart qachon? 2) Natija qachon? 3) Birlashtir.

questions.text: Hozirgi shart uchun qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: O'tmish shart uchun esa had + V3.

questions.text: O'tmishdagi natija uchun qaysi shakl ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Hozirgi natija uchun would + V1.

questions.text: «If I had known» ni inversiya bilan qanday beramiz?
questions.explanation: Rasmiy uslubda «if» tushadi, yordamchi fe'l oldinga chiqadi.

questions.text: «If I were you» ning inversiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: «If you should need» → «Should you need».

questions.text: Inversiyada inkor qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: Inversiyada qisqartma shakl ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: «but for + ot» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: But for your help, I would have failed.

questions.text: «otherwise» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.

title: Test — Wish, it's time, would rather

questions.text: «I wish I ___ fly» (qobiliyat) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Qobiliyat haqidagi orzu uchun wish + could.

questions.text: «I wish I would be taller» — bu nega xato?
options: O'zi haqida wish + would ishlatilmaydi: I wish I were taller
questions.explanation: wish + would faqat boshqa odamning harakati haqida ishlatiladi.

questions.text: «It's time we ___ » — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: It's (high/about) time + Past Simple — vaqti keldi, lekin hali bajarilmadi.

questions.text: «wish» va «hope» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: I wish I were rich ↔ I hope you pass the exam.

questions.text: «I wish I had known» qanday afsusni bildiradi?
questions.explanation: wish + Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi ishdan afsus.

questions.text: 100% inkor xulosa uchun qaysi modal ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: mustn't — TA'QIQ, xulosa emas.

questions.text: «He must have forgotten» qaysi zamonga tegishli?
questions.explanation: Hozir: must be / must be doing; o'tmish: must have + V3.

questions.text: ~50% ishonch uchun qaysi modallar ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Ular hozir ham, o'tmish ham (might have + V3) shaklida keladi.

questions.text: «should» xulosa sifatida qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: The train should be here soon — kutilgan holat.

questions.text: «must be doing» qanday ma'no beradi?
options: Hozir davom etayotgan harakat haqidagi xulosa
questions.explanation: He must be sleeping — hozir uxlayotgan bo'lsa kerak.
